name: Merab
overview: Merab was the eldest daughter of King Saul, as identified in 1 Samuel 14:49. Saul initially promised her to David as a reward for his valor and service in fighting the Lord's battles (1 Samuel 18:17), but David humbly questioned his worthiness for such an honor (1 Samuel 18:18). Ultimately, Merab was not given to David but was instead married to Adriel the Meholathite (1 Samuel 18:19), demonstrating the complexities of Saul's intentions and the unfolding of God's plan for David.
